q: Where should the Notes app send reminder pushes from?
o: A Cloud Function or trusted server
The web app, using the config
why: Sending needs Admin SDK credentials, which must never be inside the app.

q: A reminder must appear even when the app is closed, and a tap must open the right note. Which message?
o: Data only, with the note text
why: The notification part is shown by the system; the data part tells the app which note to open.

q: What should the reminder push contain?
o: The full note text and photo
A short alert and the noteId
why: Payloads are small, pass through third parties and may show on a locked screen.

q: A send fails with messaging/registration-token-not-registered. What do you do?
why: The app install is gone, so the token will never work again.

q: Naming a topic after a user's uid is a safe way to send that user private reminders.
why: On mobile any app install can subscribe to any topic name, so anyone who guesses it gets the messages.

q: A reminder is useless if it arrives more than an hour late. What do you set?
why: TTL tells FCM how long to keep trying; after that the message is dropped.

q: You run your own server (not Cloud Functions). How does the Admin SDK get credentials?
o: A service-account key file kept out of Git
why: A service-account key authorises the server; it is a real secret and must never be committed.

q: When send returns a message id, the user has seen the notification.
why: It only means FCM accepted it; delivery is best effort, so keep the truth in Firestore.
